questions.question: What should a rollback plan include?
options: Only a promise to turn the model off
A way to stop or safely reroute effects and recover state
questions.explanation: Rollback needs to account for queued work, state and downstream effects—not only the model call.

questions.question: What does production readiness provide?
options: Evidence that people can rely on the system and respond to failure
A guarantee that no incident will occur
questions.explanation: Readiness is operational evidence: evaluation, controls, visibility, support and recovery.
